statements.t: “The transaction and financing provide us with the capital and public-company foundation to advance PRA-216 and the broader INSPIRE pipeline through what we believe will be an exciting and highly data-rich period ahead,” said Sheila Gujrathi, M.D., Chief Strategy Officer of Bolt Biotherapeutics.

It is now in Phase 2 development in asthma, COPD and atopic dermatitis, with an additional study planned in eosinophilic esophagitis, and we expect patient proof-of-concept data across all four studies beginning in the second quarter of 2027.
Beyond PRA-216, we look forward to advancing additional wholly owned programs from INSPIRE as we work to build a new generation of differentiated multispecific therapies.”
The financing is expected to fund the company’s operations into 2028 and through multiple anticipated clinical and preclinical milestones.
